project.name: Beacon Website Integration
project.primary_goal: Add Beacon as Newport's Market Intelligence Agent using the supplied lighthouse mascot graphic.

agent.name: Beacon
agent.mission: Help employers and visitors discover workforce market intelligence, hiring trends, talent availability, compensation insights, industry signals, and strategic recruiting opportunities while guiding qualified conversations into Newport's business development workflow.

rules: Inspect the existing repository before making changes.
Determine framework, routing, components, styling, analytics, API conventions, and asset pipeline.
Reuse Newport's existing design system and shared UI.
Keep API credentials server-side using environment variables.
Run lint, typecheck, tests, and production build.

asset.source: Use the Beacon lighthouse mascot image supplied in this conversation.

entry_points.behavior: Introduce Beacon as Newport's market intelligence guide.
Invite employers to ask workforce and hiring questions.
Provide contextual intelligence for the current industry.

welcome.headline: Meet Beacon
welcome.subtitle: Newport's Market Intelligence Agent
welcome.message: I help leaders navigate talent markets, workforce strategy, hiring intelligence, and emerging opportunities.

capabilities.description: Provide evidence-based workforce and recruiting intelligence from approved connected data.
Explain talent supply and recruiting difficulty when verified data exists.
Present salary insights only from approved datasets.
Guide employers through recruiting strategy, staffing, RPO, offshore recruiting, and workforce planning.
Surface verified funding, hiring, leadership, stealth, or market signals when supported.
Route qualified employer conversations into Newport's business development workflow.

must_do: State uncertainty when data is unavailable.
must_not_do: Expose CRM or private candidate data.
Claim proprietary data access unless connected.

ui_requirements.desktop: Floating launcher opens a right-side conversational panel.
ui_requirements.mobile: Bottom-safe launcher opens a full-height touch sheet.
visual_direction: Beacon artwork is the primary identity

analytics.instruction: Use the website's existing analytics provider.

requirements: Keep proprietary intelligence behind server-side adapters.

acceptance_criteria: Beacon appears at all defined entry points.
Responsive desktop and mobile UX works.
Page context is passed when available.
Loading and failure states are graceful.

deliverables: Agent adapter ready for Newport OS
Implementation notes with changed files and required environment variables
